summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated environments for data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring at scale — unlike a simple model API, which just gives you inference on a pre-built model. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, need reproducibility and governance across teams, or must manage the full MLOps lifecycle; a model API suffices when you only need to call an existing model and don't manage training or infrastructure. In 2026 the landscape is converging, with hyperscaler-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) competing against data-intelligence platforms (Databricks) and specialized MLOps/AutoML tools.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/storage/endpoint hour; no upfront cost, plus optional Savings Plans
platforms.best_for: Organizations deeply invested in the AWS ecosystem needing a modular, AWS-native ML workshop

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per node-hour for training/prediction plus generative AI per-token pricing
platforms.best_for: Teams on GCP wanting strong AutoML and native access to Google foundation models

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go for underlying Azure compute/storage; no separate platform fee
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance and responsible AI tooling

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs (Databricks Units) on top of cloud compute; tiered by workload
platforms.best_for: Organizations prioritizing unified data, analytics, ML and AI governance across multiple clouds

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based paid tiers plus enterprise licensing
platforms.best_for: ML/DL research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated model building and governance with limited data-science headcount

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and platform
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting open-source-rooted AutoML with strong explainability and flexible deployment

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second serverless compute (CPU/GPU) with a free monthly credit tier
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting fast, serverless Python-native GPU compute for training and deploying models without infra management

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; per-hour Inference Endpoints and Spaces compute; enterprise plans
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source models who need a hub for fine-tuning and deploying transformers/LLMs

platforms.name: ClearML
platforms.pricing: Open-source free tier; paid Pro and enterprise tiers per usage/seat
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open-source, end-to-end MLOps stack spanning tracking, orchestration and serving
